## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall, broad-shouldered boy with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a frank face with clear, straightforward eyes. At one point, he appears rather thin, as well as pale enough to be hardly recognizable.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022)_

## Personality

Gilbert Blythe is a clever, good-natured, and ambitious individual with a strong sense of humor who actively enjoys life with great zest. Known for his teasing demeanor, he is also considered remarkably kind and thoughtful. As a dedicated student, he works hard to earn his own way through college, excelling in his examinations to lead his class, and aiming for High Honors and the Cooper Prize. Beyond his academic pursuits and talent for recitation, he is motivated by a deep desire to fight against disease, pain, and ignorance, while striving to get the best out of life and put the best into it.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. ## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he pulled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's braid and earned her fierce grudge by calling her 'Carrots.' Despite his attempted apologies and a subsequent rescue after a boating mishap, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) coldly refused his friendship for years. Gilbert engaged in a fierce academic rivalry with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), which continued through their preparations for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination and their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Upon completing their studies, Gilbert won the medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the scholarship, but Gilbert chose to teach rather than attend college. When Marilla's failing eyesight threatened [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Gilbert generously surrendered his promised position as teacher at [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could stay home and teach there instead, finally earning her friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XV. > "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship as fierce academic rivals in school after Gilbert famously pulled her braid and called her 'Carrots,' earning a broken slate over his head and Anne's long-held grudge. Although Gilbert attempted to apologize and later rescued her from a sinking boat, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) repeatedly rejected his overtures of friendship for a long time while competing with him for top marks. Eventually, the two reconciled their past animosity and became friends, though Gilbert quietly harbored deep romantic infatuation for her, even keeping a fallen rose of hers in his pocket.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +45 more_

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert and [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) started as intense academic rivals in school, constantly competing against one another until [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship while Gilbert won the medal. Over time, their dynamic softened into a quiet closeness marked by fleeting romantic sparks, such as a moment shared while tidying up after a wedding at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Their bond reaches a turning point when Gilbert falls dangerously ill with typhoid fever, prompting [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) to realize during a harrowing night vigil that she has always loved him.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), +13 more_

- Rival of — academic rivals in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>

### [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/charlie-sloane--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and Charlie are longtime friends who travel together from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). They act as close comrades during their university days, with Charlie participating in class events under Gilbert's leadership as Freshman class leader and joining him on group outings. However, a underlying tension exists between them as rivals competing for the romantic affections of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P0](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0000), [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), +14 more_

### [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/fred-wright--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) are comrades who worked together on committee assignments for the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), including canvassing the local roads. They maintain a warm acquaintance through their shared circle of friends in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). Gilbert notably attends Fred's wedding to [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), afterwards walking home with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and discussing the changes in their hometown.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), +6 more_

- Comrade of — fellow committee members assigned to canvass the White Sands road (since v2)  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010)</sub>

### [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/christine-stuart--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Christine Stuart](../character/christine-stuart.md) are friends during their time together at college. Their frequent public appearances together, such as attending the [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) reception, spark widespread rumors among their peers that the two are romantically engaged. These persistent rumors cause significant distress for [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), who secretly grieves the prospect of Gilbert marrying Christine.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Christine P0](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0000), [v3 ch.Christine P12](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0012), [v3 ch.Christine P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), +5 more_
